description: This test verifies that a user can successfully log in using Google OAuth integration and is redirected to their dashboard upon successful authentication.
steps: Assert that the page title is 'Roost Enterprise Login | Software as a Service'.
Locate the Google OAuth login button using its stable selector.
Click on the Google OAuth login button.
Verify that the browser is redirected to the Google login page.
Enter valid Google credentials (email and password) and submit the form.
Verify that the browser is redirected back to https://dev.roost.ai with the user's dashboard displayed.
Assert that the user's name or profile information is visible on the dashboard.
Verify that the URL of the current page is https://dev.roost.ai.
expected_results: User is redirected to the Google login page.
After entering valid credentials, user is redirected back to https://dev.roost.ai.
The user's dashboard is visible, indicating successful login.
edge_cases: The Google OAuth service is unavailable.
The user denies consent on the Google authorization page.
The redirection to the dashboard fails due to a network issue.
The login button is not functional due to JavaScript being disabled.
data_requirements: Access to the Google OAuth API.
Proper client ID and redirect URI configured in the Google Developer Console.
Valid session management on the Roost platform.
Access to the user's dashboard after successful login.
dependencies: Google OAuth service must be operational.
The user's Google account must be active.
The Roost platform must be configured to accept Google OAuth tokens.
api_interactions: Google OAuth API for user authentication.
Roost backend API to fetch user dashboard data post-login.
performance_metrics: Time taken to redirect from Google OAuth to the dashboard.
Response time for fetching user-specific data after login.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the Google login button is accessible via keyboard navigation.
Provide ARIA labels for the Google login button.
Verify screen reader compatibility for the login process.
